about: Swordsman line (Novice 1000, Swordsman 1100, Knight 1200, Lord Knight 1300, Rune Knight 1400): skill mechanics SkillConfig does not carry, read from each skill's own description, its talent (SpecialEffectConfig) text and timeline (SkillMechanics.cs documents every field). 'group:mode' keys override a talent mode row. Dragon Breath (11304/11305) and Sonic Wave (11309) use the generic Rect360 rule and are not listed. Everything is (inferred); 'why' quotes the evidence.

group:11210.name: Parry -> Auto Counter
group:11210.why: Parry 11210: 'When You take melee Physical damage, casts [Auto Counter] in front of You. Internal cooldown: «1» seconds'; buff 1121001-1121010 _kLogicData names the matching Auto Counter row of group 11211 (1121101-1121110, 'dealing Physical ATK*«30»%+«20» ... to «5» enemies in a «3»m*«5»m area in front of you'), so the row follows the learned Parry level.

11304.name: Dragon Breath (Fire)
11304.why: '... with a «50»% Chance to Burn damaged enemies, dealing Fire Ranged Physical damage totaling PATK * «120»% over @{1} hits': row 11382 'Burn' (1138201, script DragonBreathBurn, P1 12000, _kShowDmg [3]) is released on each enemy the breath damages with chance 5000 bp; _kBuff2 is empty so nothing else applies it. The shape stays on the generic Rect360 rule.

11002.name: Magnum Break
11002.why: '... to up to «5» enemies within a «5»-meter radius': circle of 5 m around the caster (_kRange 550 = 5.5 m).

11105.name: Auto Counter
11105.why: 'After casting, enter a Parry state for «1» sec. ... When Parry ends, perform an Auto Counter against up to «5» enemies within a «3»m * «5»m area ahead, dealing Physical ATK * «100»% + «150»': the row has no damage params, so the generic cast deals nothing; the parry buff 1110510 names the counter row in its _kLogicData [1110610] (11106 lv10: P1 10000, P2 150 = the lv10 description). Released 1000 ms later (= the parry duration, and the template's second attack point at 1.0 s). Lower skill levels still release the lv10 row (see findings).

11106.name: Auto Counter (counter strike)
11106.why: '... dealing Physical ATK*«100»%+«150» Neutral melee Physical damage to «5» enemies in a «3»m*«5»m area in front of you': _iRangeType 1 would hit only a locked target (a released counter has none); a 5 m long, 3 m wide strip from the caster (_kRange [500, 300] agrees).

11211.name: Auto Counter (Parry counter)
11211.why: '... dealing Physical ATK*«30»%+«20» Neutral melee Physical damage to «5» enemies in a «3»m*«5»m area in front of you': _iRangeType 1 would hit only a locked target; a 5 m long, 3 m wide strip from the caster (_kRange [500, 300] agrees).

11108:1.name: Brandish Spear (talent: splash)
11108:1.why: Mode 1 'dealing ... PATK * «65»%+«25» to the designated ST enemy within «5» meters and «2» Other enemies within «4» meters of the target': _iRangeType 2 Lock with _kRange [0] and _iTargetMax 1 would only hit the target; 4 m around the target, 1 + 2 targets.

11109.name: Spear Stab
11109.why: '... to the designated ST enemy within «5» meters and applying [Knockback] for «1» meters': no Spear_Stab displacement rule exists, push the target 1 m away from the caster.

11110:1.name: Spear Throw (talent: extra spear)
11110:1.why: Talent 16120008 'When casting [Spear Throw], you throw one Extra Spear that Deals DMG equal to PATK * «50»% + «220» as Extra Neutral Ranged Physical damage': mode 1 P1 [8000, 5000], P2 [80, 220], _kShowDmg [3, 1], attack points [0.07, 0.23]: the normal throw (branch 0, 3 segments) at point 0 and the extra spear (branch 1) at point 1; generic dealt only branch 0.

11110:2.name: Spear Throw (talent: explosive spear)
11110:2.why: Mode 2 'Throws an Explosive Spear at the target, dealing ... PATK * «80»%+«80» to the designated ST enemy within «12» meters and «2» Other enemies within «4» meters of the target': _iRangeType 2 Lock with _kRange [0], _iTargetMax 1; 4 m around the target, 1 + 2 targets.

11213:1.name: Spiral Pierce (talent: splash)
11213:1.why: Mode 1 '... totaling PATK * «80»%+«65» over «5» hits to the designated ST enemy within «5» meters and «2» Other enemies within «4» meters of the target': _iRangeType 2 Lock with _kRange [0], _iTargetMax 1; 4 m around the target, 1 + 2 targets.

11221:1.name: Joint Beat (talent: splash)
11221:1.why: Talent 16130011 '[Joint Beat] can also Deals DMG to «2» Other enemies within «4» meters of the target and break their body parts' (mode 1 row also carries _kDescData [..., '4', '2'] and is _iRangeType 2 Lock with _kRange [0], _iTargetMax 1): 4 m around the target, 1 + 2 targets; _kBuff2 1122101 then lands on each.

11122.name: Piercing Blast (Pierce talent proc)
11122.why: Talent 16120003 'When casting [Pierce], there is a «30»% Chance to trigger an Extra Shatter, which Deals DMG equal to PATK * «10»% + «30» ... to the target and «2» Other enemies within «4» meters' (row P1 1000, P2 30 match): _iRangeType 2 Lock with _kRange [0], _iTargetMax 1; 4 m around the target, 1 + 2 targets. The proc trigger itself is in the findings.

11124.name: Heavy Blow (Basic Attack talent proc)
11124.why: Talent 16120020 'Using [Basic Attack] triggers Splash damage, dealing Physical ATK*«50»% ... to «2» other enemies within «4» meters of the target' (row P1 5000 matches): _kRange [0] makes the splash radius 0; 4 m around the target. maxTargets 3 = target + 2 others because the selector cannot exclude the locked target (the target takes an extra 50%; see findings).

11301.name: Rift Impact
11301.why: 'Dives toward a designated location within «15» meters. Upon landing, deals ... PATK * «250»% ... to up to «5» enemies within a «5»-meter radius' (mode 1: «300»%, same «5» m): the template takes off at attack point 0 (0 s) and lands at point 1 (0.53 s); generic hit at take-off. Hit once at landing, around the requested ground point, 5 m (_kRange 600 = 6 m).

11302.name: Cleaving Slash
11302.why: 'dealing «3» hits ... totaling PATK * «50»% to up to «5» enemies within a «5»-meter radius ... Increases your MSPD by «20»% for «5» seconds' (mode 1: «55»%, same radius and MSPD): circle of 5 m around the caster (_kRange 600 = 6 m); P1 is the total with _kShowDmg [3]. _kBuff1 is empty: buff 1130201 'Dragon Wing' (_kChangeAttri [[1131, 2000]] = MSPD +20%, the attribute Rift Impact's slow lowers) for 5000 ms.

11310.name: Rain of Spears
11310.why: Modes 0/2 '... summon a barrage of spears toward the locked target, dealing «5» hits ... totaling Physical ATK*«150»% to up to «5» enemies within a «5»m*«10»m area in front of you': _iRangeType 2 Lock with _kRange [0] splashes 0 m around the target; a 10 m long, 5 m wide strip from the caster toward the target (_kLogicData [..., 600, 1100, ...] is the same box with margin).

11310:1.name: Hundred Spear - Enhance
11310:1.why: Mode 1 '... dealing «5» hits ... Physical Attack*«260»% in total to up to «5» enemies within a «10»m*«20»m area in front of you': 20 m long, 10 m wide strip from the caster (_kLogicData [..., 1100, 2100, ...]).

11310:3.name: Hundred Spear - Enhance
11310:3.why: Mode 3 '... Physical Attack*«260»% in total to up to «5» enemies within a «10»m*«20»m area in front of you': 20 m long, 10 m wide strip from the caster.

11310:4.name: Ultimate Hundred Spear
11310:4.why: Mode 4 '... Physical Attack*«1110»% in total to up to «10» enemies within a «10»m*«20»m area in front of you': 20 m long, 10 m wide strip from the caster (_iTargetMax 10).

11310:5.name: Ultimate Hundred Spear
11310:5.why: Mode 5 '... Physical Attack*«1110»% in total to up to «10» enemies within a «10»m*«20»m area in front of you': 20 m long, 10 m wide strip from the caster (_iTargetMax 10).

11315:1.name: Precision Thrust (talent mode)
11315:1.why: Mode 1 'Deals «5» hits totaling Physical ATK*«140»%' but _kShowDmg is [2] (base mode: «2» hits, [2]); P1 14000 is already the total, so keep one moment and show 5 segments.

11316.name: Sonic Burst
11316.why: '... unleashing a massive shockwave toward the locked-on target that deals ... totaling PATK * «500»% over «3» hits to up to «5» enemies in a «6»-meter by «15»-meter area in front of You' (mode 1: «600»%, same «6»m x «15»m): _iRangeType 2 Lock with _kRange [0] splashes 0 m around the target; a 15 m long, 6 m wide strip from the caster (_kLogicData [1131603, 700, 1600] is the same box with margin).
